# Real pages

`herculano-faded.pdf`: page 20 of Alexandre Herculano, *História da Origem e Estabelecimento da Inquisição em Portugal*
(1854–59, public domain), from Curió's library. The page was rendered at 150 dpi and faded the same way as
`make.py`'s `faded_scan` (grey broken ink on stained paper, JPEG 55). `herculano-faded.txt` is the book's own text for
that page, so OCR is measured against real typesetting and real Portuguese, not generated text.
